skills.name: My Name Drives Me
skills.description: Let my name become your blade. SP Hakuzousu attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK. Level 2: 105%. Level 3: 110%. Level 4: 115%. Level 5: 125%.
skills.line: Let my name become your blade.

skills.name: White Fox Seal
skills.description: Leave the rest to me! Applies Guardian Seal to an ally for 2 turns; raises the onmyoji’s move bar by 30%, and removes Seimei’s cooldown. Guardian Seal heals 20% of lost HP after each onmyoji skill. Level 2: sealed allies immune to damage. Level 3: onmyoji move bar +20% more. Level 4: enemies attacking the sealed ally get Amulet·Break (2 turns); with Seimei, his move bar +10% (once per turn, up to 3 times). Level 5: Upper Hand — targets the ally with the highest ATK.

upgrades.text: Allies who have Guardian Seal are immune to damage.
When Guardian Seal is present, the onmyoji's move bar is raised by an additional 20%.

If an ally with Guardian Seal is attacked by an enemy, then they inflict Amulet·Break onto them, lasts for 2 turn; if the onmyoji is Seimei, additionally raises his move bar by 10% (once per turn, up to 3 times before Seimei's turn starts)
Upper Hand: Guardian Seal is applied to the ally with the highest ATK.

skills.name: Dream Slash
skills.description: I’ll sever the illusory dreams! Only with Seimei present: attacks all enemies with indirect damage equal to 20% of his max HP and inflicts Amulet·Break (damage dealt -30%; start-of-turn indirect damage equal to 8% of his max HP) for 2 turns. Without Seimei, replaces Dream Slash with Mt. Dream Oath. Level 2: 25%. Level 3: recovers 20% of lost HP. Level 4: 30%. Level 5: no Onibi cost after Seimei casts a skill.

upgrades.text: Recovers 20% of the lost HP when cast.
Casts Dream Slash with no Onibi needed after Seimei casts skill.

skills.name: Mt. Dream Oath
skills.description: I swear by this body and name. Attacks all enemies with indirect damage equal to 14% of his max HP and inflicts Amulet·Break for 2 turns. Level 2: 17%. Level 3: also applies Seimei’s current Amulet: Life level. Level 4: 20%. Level 5: also applies Seimei’s current Amulet: Death level.
skills.line: I swear by this body and name.

upgrades.text: Additionally applies Seimei's current level of Amulet: Life.
Additionally applies Seimei's current level of Amulet: Death.
